Added `spec.consistentHash` support to `TrafficPolicy` and committed all changes on branch `feat/consistent-hash`:

### Summary of Changes
1. **API & CRD Schema** ([traffic_policy_types.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go), [zz_generated.deepcopy.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/zz_generated.deepcopy.go), [gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml)):
   - Added [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L618-L643) to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L47-L157) with sub-fields `disable`, `headers` ([`ConsistentHashHeader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L646-L659) and [`ConsistentHashRegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L662-L671)), `cookies` ([`ConsistentHashCookie`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L674-L696) and [`ConsistentHashCookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L699-L708)), `queryParameters` ([`ConsistentHashQueryParameter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L711-L720)), `filterState` ([`ConsistentHashFilterState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L723-L732)), and `sourceIp` ([`ConsistentHashSourceIP`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L735-L739)).
   - Added CEL validation on `ConsistentHash` ensuring no other fields may be set when `disable` is `true`.

2. **IR Construction & Route Translation** ([consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go), [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go)):
   - Implemented [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L112-L260) and [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L262-L280) to build Envoy `RouteAction_HashPolicy` entries in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`).
   - Added deduplication within each array field (case-insensitive for `headers` while preserving the first occurrence's casing), `regexRewrite` translation and regex validation for headers, Go duration and integer-seconds TTL parsing + attribute pass-through for cookies, default `sourceIp` (`terminal: false`) when `consistentHash` is empty `{}`, and suppression when `disable: true`.

3. **Policy Merging & Metadata** ([merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go), [consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go)):
   - Implemented [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L625-L665) and [`mergeConsistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L302-L378) to union array fields with higher-priority entries first, deduplicate by key, retain the higher-priority policy's `sourceIp` value (even when unset), re-sort into canonical type order, and record `consistentHash` under `merge.TrafficPolicy.gateway.kgateway.dev`.

4. **Tests** ([consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go), [cel_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8kcopbbu/api/tests/cel_test.go)):
   - Added unit and CEL validation tests covering IR construction, deduplication, canonical ordering, cookie TTL/attributes, header regex rewrite, `disable` behavior, policy merging, and merge origin metadata.
